reviewPolicy.sourcePolicy: Use the Element 62 definition and each segment table independently; Segment 143-to-102 count matching is a separate cross-segment rule.
reviewPolicy.dataPolicy: Field-level symbolic designs only. Product Code entries and delimiter-complete segments are not converter-ready fixtures.
reviewPolicy.baselinePolicy: References source-derived Segment 102/143 rules and the Segment 157 composite layout; no official Test record is modified.
reviewPolicy.promotionGate: Authorized Test review must confirm full product entries, segment delimiters/lengths, the two-segment linkage for Segment 143, and readiness before execution or promotion.

requirementReferences.title: Number of Products is 01-10 and zero-padded
Number of Products matches the actual serialized product entry count
Number of Products (Element 62) is required, 2 digits, and should match the number of products from the Product Code Data Segment
Segment 157 composite layout includes Number of Products (Element 62, 2 digits) followed by repeated product data
requirementReferences.scopeNote: Composite Test BR; this package addresses only the Number of Products component.

sourceEvidence.quote: Number: 62 Name: Number of Products Character Type: N Maximum Length: 2 bytes Representation: Fixed length of two digits Purpose: Identifies the count of products reported for a transaction. Processing Rules: Always precede single digits (1–9) with a zero (01–09). Valid Codes/Values: 01–10
sourceEvidence.interpretation: Element 62 is a two-digit numeric count, zero-padded for 1–9, with values 01–10.

sourceEvidence.quote: 4 62 Number of Products 2 R Identifies the count of products reported for this transaction.
sourceEvidence.interpretation: Segment 102 field 4 is required and identifies the product count.

sourceEvidence.quote: 3 62 Number of Products 2 R Identifies the count of products reported for this transaction. Should match the number of products from the Product Code Data Segment.
sourceEvidence.interpretation: Segment 143 field 3 is required and its count should match the Segment 102 Product Code Data Segment count.

sourceEvidence.quote: 4 62 Number of Products 2 R Identifies the count of products reported for this transaction.
sourceEvidence.interpretation: Segment 157 field 4 is required and identifies the product count.

aiReviewReferences.interpretation: All four cases show Segment 102 Element 62 = 01 and one Product Code entry. Two also show Segment 143 Element 62 = 01. These are hash-verified candidate observations, not independent verification of the product count or complete product-entry list.

testScenarios.intent: Check a zero-padded one-product count against one complete Segment 102 Product Data entry, and a deliberately mismatched count against the same entry count.
Check that Segment 143's product count matches the count of Segment 102 product entries, with one matching and one mismatching design.
Check a zero-padded one-product count against one complete Segment 157 repeated product entry; other fields in the composite rule are out of scope.

testCases.assertion: Number of Products is 01 and exactly one complete Segment 102 product entry follows.
Number of Products is 02 but only one complete Segment 102 product entry follows.
Segment 102 and Segment 143 each report 01 for the same one-product transaction.
Segment 102 reports 01 while Segment 143 reports 02 for the same one-product transaction.
Segment 157 Number of Products is 01 and exactly one complete repeated product entry follows.

openQuestions: Confirm complete product-entry serialization, delimiters, and valid product fixtures for each segment.
Confirm Segment 143 cross-segment transaction pairing and whether its count must match the Segment 102 product list in all applicable contexts.
Confirm valid Segment 157 product-entry fixture details; this draft does not validate the remaining composite Segment 157 fields.
Review the full AI payloads and sidecars before treating their repeated 01 counts as independent corroboration.
